values: crispr-mediated knockout of gsn and pln in ttn+/- cardiac microtissues significantly improves contractile stress validating them as therapeutic targets for dilated cardiomyopathy.

components.name: proposition
values: fine-tuning geneformer significantly boosts predictive accuracy for chromatin dynamics tasks compared to alternative methods.

values: in silico deletion of gata4 or tbx5 in fetal cardiomyocytes is more deleterious to their direct targets compared to indirect targets or housekeeping genes.

values: fine-tuning geneformer significantly boosts predictive accuracy for transcription factor regulatory range compared to alternative methods.

values: 0.93 0.07 bivalent versus unmethylated 0.88 0.09 bivalent versus h3k4me3-only

components.name: dataset
values: cardiomyopathy single-nucleus rna-seq data | non-failing n=9 hypertrophic n=11 dilated n=9 for training out-of-sample non-failing n=4 hypertrophic n=4 dilated n=2
heart atlas endothelial cells | about 30 000 cells

components.name: method
values: in silico perturbation | for each gene the model s input is modified to simulate deletion removing gene from top 2048 or activation duplicating gene . the effect on cell embeddings is measured via cosine similarity. disease modeling identify genes whose in silico perturbation in non-failing cells shifts embeddings toward disease state. in silico treatment identify genes whose perturbation in disease cells shifts embeddings toward non-failing.

components.name: name
values: fine-tuning for network dynamics and disease modeling

components.name: task
values: fine-tuned geneformer to classify single-nucleus rna-seq data from non-failing hypertrophic cardiomyopathy and dilated cardiomyopathy hearts into disease states.

fine-tuned geneformer to distinguish central versus peripheral factors within the notch1-dependent gene network using single-cell transcriptional data from about 30 000 normal endothelial cells from the heart atlas.
fine-tuned geneformer to distinguish notch1 downstream targets from non-targets using the same data.

performed in silico perturbation deletion/activation to identify genes whose perturbation shifts cell embeddings toward disease states disease modeling or toward non-failing state in silico treatment .

components.name: method
values: geneformer pretraining | geneformer is a context-aware attention-based deep learning model with six layers of transformer encoder units input size 2048 256 embedding dimensions four attention heads feed-forward size 512 relu activation dropout 0.02 trained with masked learning objective 15% masked max learning rate 1e-3 linear warmup adam with weight decay fix warmup steps 10000 weight decay 0.001 batch size 12 three epochs. optimized with dynamic length-grouped padding 29.4x speedup and deepspeed distributed gpu training 12 v100 gpus 3 days .

components.name: task
values: pretrained geneformer on genecorpus-30m using a self-supervised masked learning objective.

components.name: dataset
values: ipsc to cardiomyocyte differentiation transcriptomes | about 34 000-38 000 cells

components.name: method
values: geneformer fine-tuning | initialized with pretrained geneformer weights added a final task-specific transformer layer. fine-tuning hyperparameters max learning rate 5e-5 linear warmup adam with weight decay fix warmup steps 500 weight decay 0.001 batch size 12 single epoch. number of frozen layers varied per task.

components.name: task
values: fine-tuned geneformer to distinguish bivalently marked genes from unmethylated or h3k4me3-only genes using transcriptomes from about 15 000 embryonic stem cells escs and 56 labelled loci.
fine-tuned geneformer to distinguish long- versus short-range transcription factors using single-cell transcriptomes from about 34 000 cells undergoing ipsc to cardiomyocyte differentiation.
